_comment: TEMPLATE -- Raspberry Pi 4 (Broadcom BCM2711), arm64. VERIFY against your firmware/board before trusting: the RPi firmware loads the arm64 Image at 0x80000 by default and RAM base is 0x0. ram_size below is for a 2GB board; adjust for 1/4/8GB. On real HW the DTB is also auto-read from x0 at entry, so ram_base/size may not even be needed.
